scripts.tidy: go mod tidy && pnpm --dir frontend install
scripts.dev: test -f frontend/node_modules/vite/package.json || { echo 'zen: missing frontend dependencies; run: pnpm tidy' >&2; exit 1; }; (cd frontend && exec node .zen/renderers/dev-renderer.mjs) & renderer=$!; ZEN_ENV=dev go tool air -c .air.toml & app=$!; cleanup() { kill "$renderer" "$app" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$renderer" "$app" 2>/dev/null || true; }; trap cleanup 0; trap 'exit 130' INT; trap 'exit 143' TERM; while kill -0 "$renderer" 2>/dev/null && kill -0 "$app" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; exit 1
scripts.build: pnpm --dir frontend build && mkdir -p bin && go build -o ./bin/app .
scripts.start: for artifact in ./bin/app frontend/dist/server/entry-server.js frontend/dist/client/.vite/manifest.json; do test -f "$artifact" || { echo 'zen: missing production artifacts; run: pnpm build' >&2; exit 1; }; done; (cd frontend && exec node .zen/renderers/prod-renderer.mjs) & renderer=$!; ZEN_ENV=prod ./bin/app & app=$!; cleanup() { kill "$renderer" "$app" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$renderer" "$app" 2>/dev/null || true; }; trap cleanup 0; trap 'exit 130' INT; trap 'exit 143' TERM; while kill -0 "$renderer" 2>/dev/null && kill -0 "$app" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; exit 1
